verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents a programmatic Node API. `runMC` is described as safe to embed in CI scripts and servers, a reference covers embedding it in custom applications, and runs return structured JSON output with thread resume and approval controls. The probe found no OpenAPI/HTTP spec, so the public API is a library/SDK surface rather than a network API. missing for 10: a documented HTTP/REST API or OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the programmatic API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: `runMC` never calls `process.exit` and never writes to global streams, so it is safe to embed in CI scripts and servers.
Use it to embed Mastra Code in custom applications or extend its functionality.
A single final JSON object (text, usage, tool calls/results, threadId, status)
Run Mastra Code non-interactively from your shell or programmatically from Node
